title: Concept: OS command execution via system (r) — review required
description: In r, system executes operating-system commands. The weakness mechanics are identical across languages — shell metacharacters in untrusted input break out of the intended command — but the concrete sink spelling, argument conventions, and safe alternative (system2 with an args vector) are r-specific.
applicability: r codebases that launch external processes through system; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Unauthenticated command execution when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because exploitation is typically trivial and impact is full process compromise.
